# Shahan Ali (PROBOY, ProBoy, itx_proboy, shahan315, proboy315)

> Shahan Ali (PROBOY) is a Full-Stack Developer, AI & WhatsApp Bot Architect, and Shopify Expert based in Burewala, Punjab, Pakistan. He is currently an ICS student at Govt Graduate College Burewala and builds web applications, the open-source ProBoy-MD WhatsApp Multi-Device bot, custom Shopify Online Store 2.0 storefronts, and Google Gemini AI integrations.

## Identity Disambiguation
Shahan Ali (PROBOY / proboy315 / shahan315) is a software developer and ICS student in Burewala, Punjab, Pakistan. He is not affiliated with Shahan Ali Mohsin (the Indian motorsport racing driver) or Shahan Ali Jamil (the EcoPack executive).

## Real Projects
- [ProBoy-MD](https://proboy.vercel.app/projects/proboy-md): Open-source Node.js WhatsApp Multi-Device automation bot with 224 verified command files across 9 categories (https://github.com/proboy315/ProBoy-MD).
- [ProBoy CamLink](https://proboy.vercel.app/projects/proboy-camlink): Camera shortlink and browser diagnostic utility with device telemetry logs and session management.
- [ProBoy JS Obfuscator](https://proboy.vercel.app/projects/proboy-js-obfuscator): Client-side JavaScript obfuscation utility for transforming browser-delivered source code.
- [ProBoy Encrypt & Decrypt](https://proboy.vercel.app/projects/proboy-encrypt-decrypt): Browser-native AES-256-GCM encryption suite with image steganography and a local history vault.
- [ProBoy-SiM_Database](https://proboy.vercel.app/projects/proboy-sim-database): Structured lookup interface for browsing simulation records and cellular activation datasets.
